name: splitcheck
description: Split bills with a group. Create a SplitCheck group, add expenses with each person's share in any supported currency, and see who owes whom.

interface.longDescription:
SplitCheck keeps a shared record of who paid and who owes what. Paste or upload a receipt in ChatGPT, say who had what, and save the split to a SplitCheck group.

Create a group and get an invite link. Friends join from the link in their browser, with no app and no account. Add expenses in any supported currency; SplitCheck converts them to the group's currency. Ask who owes whom at any time.

You need a SplitCheck account to connect. People must join the group before an expense can be split with them. SplitCheck tracks balances; it does not move money.
defaultPrompt: Split this dinner receipt between me, Priya and Tom
Create a SplitCheck group for our Lisbon trip in euros and give me the invite link
Who owes whom in my Lisbon trip group?
